name: Nestswipe: Verified Mac backup download overdue
message:
The Monday 22:00 Europe/Paris download has no fresh checksum-verification acknowledgement after six hours. Check that the Mac is awake and online, its cron and rosen_immo/backups/.logs/download.log. The receipt proves the transfer was verified, not that the Mac still retains its disk.

If this check stops reporting for 20 minutes, investigate the host Agent and nestswipe-security-report.timer.
